subject: Web Development
title: Cookies and Tracking
description: A 60-second lesson on Cookies and Tracking.

hook.text: Cookies were invented in 1994 so online shopping carts could remember your items.

buildup.text: Small text files stored in the browser let websites remember users between visits.

discovery.text: Advertisers discovered third-party cookies could track users across the entire web.

twist.text: What was built for shopping carts became the surveillance backbone of the ad industry.

climax.text: Browsers are now killing third-party cookies. The tracking era is ending.

punchline.text: A shopping cart feature built a tracking empire.
